regimeSub: 10Y plunges 17bp to 4.96% as AI rotation sparks haven bid; SPX -0.5% but yields compress sharply.
themes: 10Y yield collapses 17bp DoD to 4.96% per FT 'winter arrives' Oct 23 as AI selloff triggers duration bid → biggest drop since 2023 banking crisis; 2Y -16bp to 4.65% signals Dec hike repricing
Fed Chair Warsh silent post-Oct 16 'price stability' remarks with no calendar events ±2d → markets lean Dec hike at 4.0% policy rate; Sep CPI 4.0% YoY (+30bp MoM) keeps inflation fears alive
BOK Oct 22 hold at 3.00% with hawkish guidance per Korea Times → USDKRW -3 to 1321 as won firms on tightening signal; KOSPI +0.8% WoW to 5465 recovering from HBM peak-out panic
Trump Oct 17 Russia sanctions waiver per Time → geopolitical risk premium fades; Brent steady at $109.48 as Iran war disruption premium persists but no fresh escalation
